title: UXReviewRecord
description: modules/fm-web -- a structured write-up of a heuristic/manual UX review of one screen or flow, produced by the frontend or ux agent. Deliberately NOT modelled as @forge/schemas' own SessionRecord type: SessionRecord's own schema (packages/schemas/src/artifacts/session-record.ts) requires started/ended/cost_usd fields a real, already-run collaboration session produces (16 §16.5) -- fields a hand-authored review of one screen has no honest value for. created/updated are date-time, not date, for the identical reason component-spec.schema.json documents: this type's own template renders them from 19 §19.2's real TemplateContext.now, which is a full ISO-8601 instant (@forge/core's Clock.now()), not a bare date. See SPEC-QUESTIONS.md Q157.

subject.description: the screen or flow reviewed, e.g. 'Checkout flow -- mobile'

severity.description: the worst single finding's own severity

findings.description: one concrete, falsifiable finding per entry

recommendation.description: the concrete next action, not a restatement of the findings
